propositions: fsck reports dirty tracker state in three classes: tracked deletions of store artifacts, untracked regenerable compaction leftovers, and orphaned .tmp-event-* files, each with distinct finding IDs in text and JSON output

doctor --repair heals dirty tracker wedges using two non-reentrant write-lock windows: one scoped window for file restoration and quarantine moves, then a second window for store convergence after lock release

backup ref refs/rebar-doctor/<utc-ts> is recorded before first mutation to provide durable audit trail; mutations refuse to proceed without a backup ref and leave no files deleted (only restored or moved to quarantine)

fsck.py registers three new TRACKER_DIRTY kinds in _STRUCTURED_KINDS and _transform_json with per-class counts and paths; porcelain parsing uses NUL-termination and shlex quoting to handle paths with special characters losslessly

doctor repair runs under scoped write_lock during file mutations (checkout + quarantine moves) with lock released before reconverge; existing class-3 (.tmp-event-*) files remain untouched and are not counted as issues

end-to-end tests verify idempotence on clean stores (zero changes, no backup ref created), lock discipline (held during mutations, released before reconverge), and unclassified .retired files are not mutated
